claim: Founder answer 2026-09-29 on nested-zone totals, verbatim pick "Show both (Recommended)", option text "Parent shows its own bottles plus a rolled-up total for everything inside, clearly labelled. Nothing hidden, no double counting in reports." Built on feat/storage-zone-parent (PR #515): zoneNesting.rolledUpTotals gives every zone with zones inside it a total of itself plus all descendants (bottles, summed recorded capacity, count of zones with no capacity, zones inside), cycle-safe, from a caller-supplied own count; rollupLabel always names what it adds up ('With the 2 zones inside: 21/150'). StorageLocationManager rows and CellarMapView cards keep their own count and add the labelled roll-up on parents only; the manager footer still sums own counts, so each bottle is counted once. Also: a zone write that lost a lock race (40P01 / 40001, e.g. a parent's soft delete against a concurrent move under it) is a 409 'try again' from StorageLocationsService.dbRefusal, and deleteLocation now goes through dbRefusal instead of a flat 500. Pinned by zoneNesting.test.ts (rolledUpTotals, rollupLabel), StorageLocationManager.rollup.test.tsx, CellarMapView.rollup.test.tsx and storage-locations-hierarchy.spec.ts ('lost a lock race').
